# cloptima_llm_virtual_key (Resource)

A Cloptima virtual key: an inference-scoped credential (ai:invoke) used to authenticate LLM gateway requests. team_id/app_id/environment/default_credential_id set here are the authoritative attribution scope for this virtual key at runtime and cannot be overridden by request headers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloptima_llm_provider_credential" "openai" {
  display_name  = "OpenAI Production"
  provider_name = "openai"
  api_key       = var.openai_api_key
}

resource "cloptima_llm_virtual_key" "copilot_prod" {
  name                  = "customer-copilot-prod-key"
  team_id               = "engineering"
  app_id                = "customer-copilot"
  environment           = "production"
  default_credential_id = cloptima_llm_provider_credential.openai.id
  expires_in_days       = 180
}

# The virtual key's client bearer token is returned once upon creation:
output "copilot_virtual_key_token" {
  value     = cloptima_llm_virtual_key.copilot_prod.access_token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Virtual key display name.

### Optional

- `app_id` (String) Authoritative app attribution for requests made with this virtual key.
- `default_credential_id` (String) Default BYOK credential ID used by this virtual key.
- `default_credential_ids` (String) Per-provider default credential IDs as a JSON object.
- `environment` (String) Authoritative environment attribution for requests made with this virtual key.
- `expires_in_days` (Number) Virtual key lifetime in days from creation. Changing this value replaces the virtual key (a new secret is minted) rather than updating it in place.
- `membership_id` (String) Membership ID this virtual key is issued under. Defaults to the calling identity's own membership when omitted. Immutable after creation.
- `team_id` (String) Authoritative team attribution for requests made with this virtual key.

### Read-Only

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) The raw virtual key value. Returned only once at creation and retained only in Terraform state.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `customer_id` (String) Owning customer ID.
- `env_var` (String) Suggested environment variable name for this virtual key.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry timestamp, if any.
- `id` (String) Virtual key ID.
- `masked_access_token` (String) A masked/displayable form of the virtual key value.
- `resolved_policy_preview` (Attributes) The gateway policy this virtual key resolved to at issue time, given its team/app/environment scope - the same governance preview a console admin would see. Set only at creation; not refreshed on subsequent reads. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resolved_policy_preview))
- `status` (String) Virtual key status: active or revoked.
- `token_prefix` (String) Non-secret prefix of the issued virtual key, safe to log.
- `token_type` (String) Token type, e.g. Bearer.
